value.hook: Read before a dependency-free JavaScript review in a detached worktree.
value.title: Dependency-free review readiness gap

sections.name: body
sections.value: Review-only PR #234 exposed two harness difficulties. First, the core harness instructions advertise observe, but harness help lists only boot/checks and harness instructions observe returns unconfigured. Second, harness boot stops at missing worktree dependencies before reaching scoped dependency-free node:test proof. Do not repair shared dependencies or create node_modules symlinks for a bounded review. Use supported exact-head targeted tests or exact-head CI evidence and distinguish those receipts from full readiness. magicWand: a scoped review-readiness command that discovers dependency-free tests and reports their proof separately from whole-repository TypeScript readiness. Suggested encoding: add a review scope to the boot/checks surface and make the briefing advertise only installed capture verbs. This is harness feedback, not a PR defect.
